physical_config_note: frozen flow files, lambda2 thresholds, integration parameters, cleaning and 3/1/1 head blocks are read from this file; nothing else of GTHeadCoverage 1.1 is reused

dataset.role: Task4-c fixed bundle dataset v1; long-term read-only after audit-data

instance_split.rule: hairpin GT instances (VortexIds, including 0) per flow; overlapping GT boxes stay in one group; exactly round(0.2 n) held-out instances when achievable, otherwise the largest achievable count below it

coverage.definition: center inside the GT instance volume and |cos(velocity,vorticity)|^2 < 0.5 (GTHeadCoverage 1.1 head condition); an instance is covered by a split when the split has >= min_head_centers such centers
coverage.test: every instance (covered: GT-head rows; held-out: GT-box rows)
coverage.pairing: every covered-instance test positive gets >=1 training center inside the same GT instance, satisfying the head condition, at 1h..6h (h of the test row); unpaired test positives are removed and coverage is re-checked
coverage.train_topup: after pairing, every covered instance with fewer than target non-relaxed GT-head training rows receives GT-head rows (GT membership, head angle, lambda2<threshold, oyf>0, >=1h from evaluation centers) up to the target when achievable; the hard requirement is min_head_centers
coverage.test_target: every instance gets GT-head test rows up to the target when achievable; the hard requirement is min_head_centers
coverage.heldout_test: held-out instances: test centers uniformly random inside the instance GT box, no lambda2/oyf/angle filter (user rule 2026-09-18 evening: no added rules); label = GT membership of the center; coverage of a held-out instance = test centers inside its GT box

distances.note: h is the local grid spacing (geometric mean). Generation order test -> validation -> train: validation >= 0.5 h_test from test centers; training >= 1 h_eval from every validation/test center; covered-instance test positives have a paired same-instance training center within 6h; training/validation never enter a held-out GT box (no margin)

proposals.center_filter: head-region centers: oyf>0 and same head component (frozen 4.14 rule); GT-head centers: GT membership, head angle, lambda2<threshold, oyf>0
proposals.neighbor_filter: in-domain only; all 26 stencil neighbours are integrated
proposals.relaxation: after normal_attempts (100) consecutive failures of one head / instance / pairing target the center filter is dropped; label = GT membership of the center

storage.geometry.npy: float32 [N,27,32,3] normalized lines, slot 0 = center line
storage.metadata.npz: labels, counts, head_component, instance, scale_id, center_number, source_cell, center, centroid, radius, bounds, neighbor_distance, seed_rms_distance, measured_mean_arc_length, half_arc_lengths, half_step_counts, ds, maxiteration, requested_half_length, local_grid_scale, nearest_train_center_distance, nearest_same_head_train_center_distance
storage.index.npz: sample_kind (0 head region / 1 GT head / 2 held-out GT box), relaxed, neighbor_filter (1 in-domain / 2 relaxed), original_center_id (0), nearest_instance, heldout_instance, center_gt_owner, center_in_gt_head, offset_test, paired_test_center
storage.line_seed_attributes.npz: seed_points, stencil_slot, exact_stencil_coordinates, lambda2, oyf, inside, head_candidate, oyf_positive, lambda2_threshold
